Japan's PM Takaichi visits India for annual summit on trade, security

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is visiting India for the 20th annual summit between the two nations. The visit, scheduled for July 1-3, 2026, aims to deepen bilateral ties, focusing on economic security, energy, investment, and technological cooperation. Discussions are also expected to include a direct yen-rupee trade settlement framework, with Japan reportedly considering a significant investment in India.
